standard.definition: Source decomposition verifies that the dashboard route implementation imports or calls shared @hermes/dashboard-kit primitives directly. Rendered HDK markers, copied CSS, mount-only shells, and server-rendered string HTML are tracked as partial until the route is package-native by source.
standard.blockingRule: A project can pass rendered certification while still needing source decomposition. Strict source promotion requires all primary operator surfaces to be package-native-route or explicitly exceptioned.
